teredo_server_primary.description: Primary Teredo server hostname or IP address.

teredo_server_backup.description: List of backup Teredo server hostnames or IPs.

items.description: Backup Teredo server hostname or IP address.

teredo_interface.description: Network interface to bind Teredo to (e.g., eth0). Leave empty to auto-detect.

teredo_port.description: UDP port used for Teredo traffic (standard: 3544).

client_bind_address.description: Local IPv6 address to bind the client socket. Leave empty for automatic selection.

tunnel_prefix.description: IPv6 prefix assigned to the Teredo tunnel (e.g., 2001:0:1::/48). Leave empty to auto-assign.

teredo_max_tunnels.description: Maximum number of concurrent tunnels to maintain.

teredo_log_level.description: Verbosity of log output. Options: debug, info, warning, error, critical.

enable_stateless_addrconf.description: Enable IPv6 stateless address autoconfiguration for the tunnel interface.

enable_nat_traversal.description: Enable optimized NAT traversal (helps with symmetric NATs).

client_ipv6_addresses.description: Additional IPv6 addresses to assign to the Miredo client interface.
